question: Why did water-accessible pores make up most of the total pore space after solvent extraction in the CV-SANS results?
expect: premise false: water-accessible pore space rose only slightly and still made up less than 30% of the total pores (abstract; sec. 3)
rendered: The document does not state that water-accessible pores made up most of the total pore space after solvent extraction in the CV-SANS results.
